+import os, datetime
+from tsfile import (TsFileTableWriter, TableSchema, ColumnSchema, ColumnCategory, TSDataType, Tablet)
+
+def write(path, cols, rows, table='sensors'):
+    if os.path.exists(path): os.remove(path)
+    schema = TableSchema(table, [ColumnSchema(n, t, c) for n,t,c in cols])
+    names=[n for n,_,_ in cols]; types=[t for _,t,_ in cols]
+    w = TsFileTableWriter(path, schema)
+    tab = Tablet(names, types, len(rows))
+    for i,(ts,vals) in enumerate(rows):
+        tab.add_timestamp(i, ts)
+        for n,v in vals.items():
+            if v is not None: tab.add_value_by_name(n,i,v)
+    w.write_table(tab); w.close()
+
+# File A: devices d0,d1; fields temp(FLOAT), hum(INT32)
+write('/tmp/a.tsfile',
+  [('plant',TSDataType.STRING,ColumnCategory.TAG),('dev',TSDataType.STRING,ColumnCategory.TAG),
+   ('temp',TSDataType.FLOAT,ColumnCategory.FIELD),('hum',TSDataType.INT32,ColumnCategory.FIELD)],
